shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

for f in index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done; echo "=== node ==="; node -v; npm -v; ls node_modules | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "--- version:" && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && echo "--- peers:" && node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependencies)" && echo "--- styles:" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ && echo "--- components:" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | grep -iE 'TextInput|PasswordInput|Checkbox|Button|ThemeProvider|Card|Text$|Flex|layout'

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | tr '\n' ' ' && echo && echo "--- controls:" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls 2>/dev/null && echo "--- ThemeProvider:" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && echo "--- optional peers:" && node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependenciesMeta)" && echo "--- exports:" && node -p "Object.keys(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').exports || {}).join(' ')" && echo "--- installed react:" && node -p "require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version"

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && echo "=== README setup ===" && grep -n -A12 -iE '^## (Usage|Install|Getting started)' $U/README.md | head -60; echo "=== ThemeProvider props ==="; cat $U/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo "=== TextInput props ==="; cat $U/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; echo "=== PasswordInput props ==="; cat $U/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; echo "=== controls common types ==="; sed -n 1,80p $U/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && echo "=== README styles/theme section ===" && grep -n -B2 -A14 -iE 'styles\.css|ThemeProvider' $U/README.md | head -80; echo "=== Checkbox ==="; cat $U/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo "=== Button ==="; sed -n 1,60p $U/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo "=== Card ==="; cat $U/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo "=== Flex ==="; sed -n 1,60p $U/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo "=== Text ==="; sed -n 1,40p $U/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && echo "=== README Provider snippet ===" && sed -n 52,62p $U/README.md && grep -n -B3 -A20 '<Provider' $U/README.md | head -60; echo "=== Provider.d.ts ==="; cat $U/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; echo "=== ControlProps ==="; grep -n -A25 'interface ControlProps' $U/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo "=== Button types ==="; sed -n 1,80p $U/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts; echo "=== AI docs index ==="; sed -n 1,80p $U/build/docs/INDEX.md

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat $U/build/esm/components/theme/LangProvider.d.ts; echo "--- i18n langs:"; ls $U/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/i18n/ 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "lang" $U/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -5

sed -i 's/<Text as="label" variant="body-1" {...{ htmlFor: '"'"'login-email'"'"' }}>/<Text as="label" variant="body-1" htmlFor="login-email">/; s/<Text as="label" variant="body-1" {...{ htmlFor: '"'"'login-password'"'"' }}>/<Text as="label" variant="body-1" htmlFor="login-password">/' src/pages/LoginPage.tsx && grep -n 'as="label"' src/pages/LoginPage.tsx && rm -rf dist && printf 'node_modules/
__agent_eval__/
dist/
' > .gitignore && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK; echo "--- test deps:"; ls node_modules | grep -E '^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$'; ls node_modules/@testing-library 2>/dev/null; echo "--- git status:"; git status --short

sed -i 's#expect(html).toMatch(/<input\[^>\]\*type="checkbox"\[^>\]\*name="remember"/);#expect(html).toMatch(/<input[^>]*name="remember"[^>]*type="checkbox"/);#' src/pages/LoginPage.test.tsx && grep -n 'checkbox' src/pages/LoginPage.test.tsx && echo "=== vitest ===" && npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests|✓|✗|FAIL' && echo "=== build ===" && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|✓ built|dist/' ; rm -rf dist; echo "=== git status ===" && git status --short && echo "=== package.json deps ===" && node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').dependencies)"
